description: Rejecting twin of p45: the same payload, with expected_digest computed over {"a":"\u2028\u2029"}, both separators written as escapes. Go encoding/json emits that text for this payload, with or without SetEscapeHTML(false) (measured, go1.27.1), so it is the digest a canonicalizer built on it computes. RFC 8785 section 3.2.2.2 does not escape them: the escaped text is not the canonical form, and its digest does not commit to this payload. An engine that escapes them rejects p45 and accepts this vector; one that accepts either form accepts this vector only.
